jobs.descriptionText:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.
Responsibilities
Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications
15+ years of relevant experience
Experience in people management
Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
Series 79 and 63 licenses
Education
Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master’s degree preferred
Engage in the buildout of China equity capital markets team and design internal deal process, policy and procedures
Lead origination and execution of global ECM transactions with a strong focus on China A-share transactions Lead and manage end-to-end execution of ECM transactions including A-share IPOs, follow-on offerings, rights issues, convertible bonds, and equity-linked products on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE), and STAR Market (科创板)
Drive origination of new ECM mandates through proactive client engagement, sector expertise, and market intelligence
Coordinate cross-border equity transactions including H-share listings, A+H dual listings, and HKEX IPOs for China-based issuers
Oversee preparation of prospectuses, offering memoranda, regulatory filings, and investor marketing materials to the highest standard of accuracy and compliance
10+ years of relevant ECM origination and execution experience with a deep understanding of China A-share market as well as good knowledge of global capital markets
Solid understanding of local financial markets and ECM product knowledge
Preferably also equipped with DCM product knowledge
Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
Experience of covering local institutional investors
Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities

jobs.title: Treasury Risk officer - VP, Risk
jobs.descriptionText:
Citibank China Company Ltd. (‘CCCL’) is Citibank’s locally incorporated subsidiary with full-fledged banking license serving the Mainland China market. Second Line of Defense (‘2LoD’) oversight for Liquidity Risk, Non-Trading Market Risk (Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book - IRRBB), and Balance Sheet Risks is executed by Finance CRO (FinCRO).
The Treasury Risk Vice President (C13) leads independent 2LoD oversight, risk limit framework design/recalibration, quantitative risk analysis, and credible challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk and Liquidity Risk across CCCL.
The role ensures robust governance across risk appetite, intraday liquidity, internal/regulatory liquidity stress testing, IRRBB supervisory frameworks (including Supervisory Outlier Tests), behavioral modeling assumptions, and regulatory compliance with PBOC/NFRA and Basel standards.
Job Background / Context
CCCL’s Independent Risk Management acts as the second line of defense for the holistic management of risk across all business lines and entities in China. Within Independent Risk Management, the Finance CRO team provides independent oversight, review, and credible challenge to 1LoD functions (Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and Global Markets).
The team ensures CCCL maintains an adequate liquidity profile, resilient intraday payment/settlement capacity, and an optimized balance sheet structure that operates strictly within Board-approved Risk Appetite thresholds for Liquidity, IRRBB, Capital Adequacy, and Investments. The VP serves as a senior subject matter expert driving quantitative risk analytics, limit calibrations, and regulatory engagements.
Key Responsibilities
Risk Limit Setting, Calibration & Risk Appetite Framework
Limit Setting & Recalibration: Lead the periodic and ad-hoc review, establishment, and quantitative recalibration of CCCL’s Treasury Risk Limit Framework covering Liquidity, IRRBB, and balance sheet structure.
Risk Appetite & Triggers: Formulate and recalibrate Board-approved Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), Early Warning Indicators (EWIs), and management triggers to reflect balance sheet changes, business strategy, and market dynamics.
Methodology Challenge: Provide formal 2LoD challenge on underlying limit methodologies, allocation waterfalls, buffer sizing, and scenario severity parameters.
Liquidity Risk Management & Intraday Liquidity Oversight
Intraday Liquidity Oversight: Drive 2LoD monitoring and independent oversight of intraday liquidity risk, time-critical payment/clearing obligations (CNAPS/CIPS), and intraday collateral mobilization.
Payment Buffer & Collateral Adequacy: Assess and challenge CCCL’s intraday liquidity buffers, credit lines, central bank pledged collateral, and overdraft facilities under normal and stressed conditions.
Contingency Funding Planning (CFP): Review and challenge the operational feasibility of CCCL’s Contingency Funding Plan, liquidity escalation triggers, and asset monetization capabilities.
Liquidity Stress Testing (LST) & Scenario Modeling
Internal Stress Testing (ILST): Lead 2LoD review and credible challenge of CCCL’s Internal Liquidity Stress Testing frameworks, Resolution Liquidity Adequacy (RLAP/RLEN), and survival horizon metrics.
Scenario Design & Assumptions: Assess the severity and relevance of idiosyncratic, systemic, and combined stress scenarios; review cash flow projections, deposit runoff assumptions, contingent liquidity draws, and wholesale funding rollovers.
HQLA Buffer Sizing: Evaluate the sizing, composition, currency mix, and unencumbered status of CCCL’s High-Quality Liquid Assets buffer.
Regulatory Compliance & Standards (Liquidity & IRRBB)
Liquidity Regulatory Ratios: Ensure continuous 2LoD monitoring and compliance with PBOC and NFRA regulatory ratios, including Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), Liquidity Ratio (LR), and Net Cumulative Outflow metrics.
IRRBB Regulatory Frameworks: Ensure strict compliance with NFRA IRRBB Guidelines for Commercial Banks, PBOC macroprudential requirements, and Basel BCBS 368 standards.
Supervisory Outlier Tests (SOT): Lead the 2LoD assessment, validation, and monitoring of regulatory SOT for
Regulatory Reporting & Exams: Oversee and validate local regulatory IRRBB returns, interest rate repricing gap schedules, and supervisory stress test submissions; provide technical risk support for PBOC/NFRA examinations and inquiries.
Regulatory Change: Track, interpret, and drive the implementation of evolving prudential standards across IRRBB, Credit Spread Risk in the Banking Book (CSRBB), and liquidity metrics (BCBS 248 / Basel III/IV).
Non-Trading Market Risk (IRRBB) & Modeling Assumptions
IRRBB Metrics Oversight: Review, analyze, and challenge banking book interest rate risk metrics, including Economic Value of Equity (EVE) sensitivity, Earnings at Risk (EaR), and Net Interest Income (NII) sensitivity.
Behavioral Assumptions: Review and challenge behavioral modeling assumptions for non-maturity deposits (NMDs), loan prepayments, deposit early redemptions, and Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) rules.
Variance & P&L Attribution: Supervise detailed variance analysis and driver attribution explaining balance sheet metric movements.
Governance, Committee Presentation & Risk Culture
Senior Governance Forums: Prepare risk analytics and actively participate in the Asset and Liability Committee (ALCO), Country Risk Management Committee (RMC), and Country Coordination Committee (CCC).
ICAAP & Resolution Planning: Provide critical 2LoD input and independent challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk (IRRBB) and Liquidity Risk sections of the ICAAP and Recovery & Resolution Plans.
Audit & Control Remediation: Serve as primary risk contact for Internal Audit and external regulatory examinations; drive the timely remediation of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) and Manager's Control Assessments (MCA).
Conduct & Ethics: Uphold the highest standards of conduct, ethics, and compliance, transparently managing and escalating risk and control issues.
Development Value
Direct Franchise Impact: High-visibility role managing and defending the treasury, IRRBB, and liquidity risk profile of Citi's onshore China banking franchise (CCCL).
Senior Stakeholder Exposure: Strategic interface with senior franchise leadership (CCCL CRO, Treasurer, CFO, and Regional FinCRO heads).
Regulatory & Technical Mastery: Advanced exposure to onshore PBOC/NFRA and Basel regulatory regimes, leading limit recalibration, stress testing, and supervisory outlier evaluations.
Career Growth: High-impact leadership track offering clear progression into broader regional Treasury Risk and Country CRO roles.
Person Specification
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Quantitative Risk Management, Financial Engineering, or Accounting. Master’s degree or professional certifications (FRM, CFA) strongly preferred.
Subject Matter Expertise: In-depth technical mastery of Liquidity Risk (LCR, NSFR, ILST, intraday liquidity, collateral management) and IRRBB / ALM (EVE, EaR, NII sensitivity, yield curve modeling, CSRBB).
Experience: 6–10+ years of relevant experience in Treasury Risk Management, Liquidity Risk, Balance Sheet / ALM Risk, or Non-Trading Market Risk in banking or financial institutions.
Limit Calibration & Analytics: Proven expertise in designing, quantitatively calibrating, and backtesting risk limits, stress scenarios, and early warning trigger frameworks.
Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of PBOC and NFRA regulatory rules, reporting standards, Basel III/IV frameworks, BCBS 248 intraday metrics, and BCBS 368 IRRBB standards.
Credible Challenge: Confident executive presence with the ability to provide robust, credible challenge to 1LoD Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and business heads.
Legal Entity Risk: Experience working within a locally incorporated bank subsidiary or material legal entity environment.
Technical Tools: High proficiency in Advanced Excel/VBA, SQL, and financial risk engines; experience with Python or BI tools and applying AI/automation to streamline workflows.
Language Skills: Full professional fluency in written and spoken English and Mandarin (Putonghua) is mandatory.
Communication & Governance: Strong communication and memo-writing skills to articulate complex balance sheet, liquidity, and rate risk dynamics clearly to senior governance committees (ALCO/RMC/Board).
Examinations & Audits: Prior experience participating in regulatory examinations, risk assessments, and internal audits.
Execution & Resilience: Self-driven, highly organized, and capable of prioritizing and delivering under tight timelines.

Ensure internal stakeholders are proactively informed of client needs, product requirements, and strategic priorities to foster alignment and drive execution.

This role offers significant strategic development opportunities, including:
In-depth Strategic Understanding:
Cultivate a profound understanding of customer Treasury organizations, specific industries, treasury functions, and the Treasury and Trade Services (TTS) business, its products, risks, and controls, enhancing strategic insight.
Expanded Global Network & Strategic Relationships:
Grow your Citi network across the globe, establishing key strategic relationships that drive business outcomes.
Accelerated Career Advancement:
Expand and strengthen strategic knowledge, paving the way for advanced opportunities within Sales, Product, or Risk leadership

Strategic Thinking:
Ability to develop forward-looking plans that deliver sustainable growth and a competitive advantage.

Proven experience in motivating and guiding cross-functional teams to achieve ambitious strategic goals.

Transaction Management will be responsible for supporting multiple aspects of the lending lifecycle including but not limited to loan closing and servicing coordination, facilitating complex client onboarding, data management, and quality control. The team will be accountable and responsible for operational oversight of the closing and servicing of all loan transactions of the business division being supported to ensure all internal and external requirements are met.

Contribute to the build and development team to support loan origination and lifecycle management which includes large complex syndicated and bilateral loans covering but not limited to corporate, commercial, real estate, structured lending and trade.
Assist with the creation of processes, standards, procedures, controls, training, and implementation of transaction management.
Aid in the design and implementation of technology including testing and rollout.
Provide training and support to transaction management staff and business constituents.
Partner with each of the originating and coverage business lines, credit risk, operations, legal, etc.

Work with lines of business, transaction management, and loan operations to define and implement operational metrics and risk and control reviews to ensure all stakeholders have end to end transparency.
Constantly improve processes, controls and efficiencies within the group and front to back across loan lifecycle
Participate in projects to enhance performance and efficiency.
Take part in loan remediation and loan system testing / migrations.
Actively manage and maintain a deal closing pipeline of loan transactions.
Coordinate and close loan transactions/lifecycle events, capture data, store documentation, troubleshoot issues/roadblocks, perform quality control
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
5-8 years of experience
Individual must have excellent communication, organizational and interpersonal skills.
Individual must work well under tight deadlines, manage priorities, and complete assigned tasks with minimal management follow up.
Candidate has quantitative skills with a high proficiency with Excel and other Microsoft based programs.
Tableau or visualization tool familiarity
Experience with Loan IQ, transaction capture tools, etc.
Keen attention to detail
Developed analytical and problem-solving abilities
Client relationship and solution skills
Additional Non-core Qualifications Which Will Be Considered Are
Experience within a large global team supporting wholesale lending at large financial Institution
Knowledge of wholesale loan (syndicated / bilateral) product and business, including an understanding of legal loan documentation, loan / funding mechanics, deal structure, funds flows, etc.
Experience working with clients under time constraints to facilitate a transaction or process.
Proven ability to collaborate with team members, Senior management and other business constituents
Critical decision-making capabilities including the ability to identify, escalate, and propose solutions to problems
Ability to prioritize through the practice of strong organizational and time management skills with experience in continuously following-up with various stakeholders
Understanding and awareness of appropriate corporate and regulatory policies in relation to Lending
Deep understanding of operational processes supporting Wholesale lending
Focus on achieving/exceeding key operating standards within a KPI/metrics driven culture
Ability to work in an environment where priorities are frequently changing

jobs.title: Supervisory Analyst / Editor / Designated Quality Review Officer - Shanghai
jobs.descriptionText:
Description
Citi Research delivers industry-leading investment analysis to Citi’s global institutional investor and wealth management client base. Our team includes some 350 publishing analysts globally, with fundamental coverage of ~3,600 equity securities, as well as areas such as quantitative analysis, economics, fixed-income/rates/credit, FX, commodities, and data analytics. We also deliver access services such as conferences & events, corporate access & visits, and direct insights from market, policy, and industry experts.
Citi Research is seeking a
Supervisory Analyst / Editor / Designated Quality Review Officer (DQRO)
to join our nascent Shanghai-based Research office under Citigroup Securities (China) Co. Ltd. This is a role for a seasoned professional combining responsibilities in editorial, risk management, and operational processes. This role will primarily support and review research product produced by our new Shanghai team, both in English and Chinese. The role may also involve some review of global ex-PRC research product. The role requires strong editorial skills and financial/investment topics comprehension in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Attention to detail is a must!
Key Responsibilities
Review investment research product to ensure compliance with PRC and US FINRA regulations, including reasonable basis and sourcing requirements.
Review investment research product to ensure compliance with Citi’s internal research content guidelines, as detailed in our research guidebooks and policies.
Edit investment research for quality, clarity, commerciality, style, and grammar.
Review both Chinese and English variants, including cross-checking consistency.
Review investment research language/tone and content for franchise risk, with consideration of the firm's reputation and business exposures, and in light of PRC and global political and client sensitivities. Be capable of editing to mitigate such risks (while maintaining our independent views), as well as determining when escalation is appropriate.
Handle the checking of investment research product for 1) issuer mentions for cross-checking against our Watch List; 2) the inclusion of appropriate disclaimers & disclosures; 3) data consistency; and 4) distribution tagging and other product & template elements.
Act as an editorial project manager, providing end-to-end traffic management of work-in-progress, liaising as needed with analyst teams, other Publications staff, product managers, control & compliance teams, data and technical support teams, and other relevant partners, to resolve problems and ensure product ultimately publishes. Additional managerial responsibilities may be assigned, given the need for flexibility in the small startup team.
Broadly as a Citi staffer, assess risk appropriately when business decisions are made, work in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to policies, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
Have passed the examination uniformly organized by the CSRC for securities business personnel; Securities Association of China (SAC) test.
Holding a FINRA Series-16 license is a major advantage. We may also consider strong candidates without Series-16 and would sponsor them to sit the exam, including providing study materials. Quick study prep time and then successfully passing this challenging exam is a requirement for the role.
Candidate should have at least five years of experience creating, supporting, or editing investment/financial analytic content. Candidate should be a fluent Chinese and English speaker with evidence of editorial and writing capability.
We expect candidates to have strong familiarity with financial markets, financial terminology, and ongoing business news in PRC, Asia, and globally.
Ability to prioritize and to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously amid tight deadlines.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to exercise sound and balanced judgment.
Meticulous and detail oriented. Key aspects of the role involve being able to remember and apply many guidelines and procedures on a consistent and reliable basis.
Team members should have comfort working with sometimes complex publishing software platforms (e.g. Sinitek) and ability to coordinate with partner teams when trouble-shooting technical issues.
Team player with good interpersonal skills, and the patience and diplomacy to work with demanding internal customers and effectively find win-win solutions.
This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

Other Key Requirements
Bachelor’s undergraduate university degree or higher
PRC nationality
Have complete civil capacity; be of good moral character, fair-minded and honest, and possess sound professional ethics.
Have not incurred any criminal penalty or any serious administrative penalty related to securities or futures business.

jobs.descriptionText:
You're the brains behind our work.
You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.
What is Services?
Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.
In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
The Citi Services 10-week Summer Analyst Program gives entry-level employees hands-on experience through training sessions and real, on-the-job learning. Summer Analysts work closely with their teams, owning projects that drive meaningful impact. After an initial week of training and a placement process based on your interests and our needs, you’ll be assigned to a team where you’ll focus on financial analysis, business development, client engagement, and market research.
Your Time Here Will Look Something Like This
Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth.
Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk.
Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings.
Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership.
Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.
We want to hear from you if…
You are a junior in college, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028, with a preferred GPA of 3.5 or above.
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook.
You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn.
Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit…
We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for:
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Excellent communication skills.
A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail.
Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self-starter.
A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn.
Resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.
Your future at Citi
Successful Summer Analysts may be invited to return as full-time Analysts upon graduation. During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future where technology and AI play an increasingly central role. You will develop skills that are not only relevant today but are also essential for navigating the evolving landscape of AI-driven financial services.
Join us and take the first step toward shaping the future of Citi!
We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in APAC region.

Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Manager, Governance Office.
Principal responsibilities
This key role will support to establish and execute a governance framework that will orchestrate resources and expertise across markets that aligns with business strategy.
The Role Is Responsible For
Designing and implementing robust, risk-based governance frameworks for corridors, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations across jurisdictions
Managing key stakeholder meetings, including Risk Stewards Forum and risk calibration meetings
Developing and maintaining manuals and risk assessment tools for cross-border risk management.
Ensuring tracking and reporting cross-border MI dashboard into governance forums
Maintaining oversight on key risks impacting business strategy with periodic reviews on external trends and internal control environment
Effective engagement with internal stakeholders across businesses, risk stewards and across markets.
Requirements
Solid experience, exposure and understanding of banking and financial services industry, regulatory and economic environment across mainland China and Hong Kong, with experience in navigating complex compliance environments
Proven ability in working across multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural diverse work environment
Strong business acumen, risk awareness and critical thinking, able to make good judgement that balance customer centricity, business and risk considerations
Self-motivated and proactive with excellent skills in navigating and influencing stakeholders at different levels
Strong project management skills and ability to drive results through others
Fluent in English and Chinese, both written and spoken
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
